method: Hand-curated, date-and-venue pointers from the cited year/tour index. The base catalog contains separately researched concert dossiers. This index does not assert a complete setlist, lineup, performance duration, guest or tape availability. The source is linked directly to permit later review. Phish.net and Goose Index are independent fan sources, not official band databases.

spotlight.title: First Fillmore West stand
spotlight.summary: The band’s official memorabilia archive labels January 15, 1970 as its first Fillmore West show. This is a source-backed event-history note, not evidence of an extant tape.

spotlight.title: The Palladium — first Sunrise
spotlight.summary: The official show entry identifies this performance as the first Sunrise and documents a show setlist.

spotlight.title: Cornell — canonical show record
spotlight.summary: The band’s show archive identifies Scarlet Begonias, Fire on the Mountain, St. Stephen, Not Fade Away and Morning Dew in the setlist.

spotlight.title: The Great Went — opening night
spotlight.summary: The first of the two Great Went festival performances, part of the multi-set event at the former Loring Air Force Base.

spotlight.title: The Great Went — second night
spotlight.summary: The second of the two Great Went performances. The community archive describes an Art Jam and a Digital Delay Loop Jam within the event.

spotlight.title: Denver 1997 — official archival release
spotlight.summary: Phish.net identifies this show as the performance issued as Live Phish 11 and notes Ghost into Fire in the first set.

spotlight.title: Champaign — a quoted lyrical reference
spotlight.summary: Phish.net notes Meatstick quotes in the transition from Fee into Run Like an Antelope.

spotlight.title: Auburn Hills 1997 — second-set sequence
spotlight.summary: The Phish.net record marks a sequence beginning with Tweezer and continuing through Izabella, Twist and Piper.

spotlight.title: Deer Creek — Rhinoceros debut
spotlight.summary: Phish.net identifies this show as the live debut of the Smashing Pumpkins cover Rhinoceros.

spotlight.title: Atlanta — Van Halen debut
spotlight.summary: The setlist notes report the Phish debut of Runnin’ with the Devil in the encore.

spotlight.title: Walnut Creek — eclipse narration
spotlight.summary: The show notes document a lunar-eclipse explanation in the Colonel Forbin’s Ascent / Fly Famous Mockingbird narrative.

spotlight.title: Merriweather — double debut
spotlight.summary: The Phish.net account identifies the first Phish performances of Sweet Jane and Sabotage at this show.

spotlight.title: Virginia Beach — Garcia remembrance
spotlight.summary: Phish.net documents the band performing Terrapin Station on the third anniversary of Jerry Garcia’s death.

spotlight.title: Star Lake — Marley opener
spotlight.summary: The published notes identify this performance as the band’s debut of Trench Town Rock.

spotlight.title: Los Angeles — Beatles encore
spotlight.summary: Phish.net identifies Something as a debut in this Greek Theatre encore.

spotlight.title: Halloween 1998 — Velvet Underground costume
spotlight.summary: The second set covers the Velvet Underground album Loaded; this is the published setlist context, not an inference from the tour listing.

spotlight.title: Grand Rapids — documented archival release
spotlight.summary: The Phish.net concert note identifies this performance as available through LivePhish. It does not on its own define a recording lineage.

spotlight.title: Cleveland — Mind Left Body reference
spotlight.summary: The Phish.net annotation identifies a Mind Left Body Jam between portions of Wolfman’s Brother.

spotlight.title: Hampton 1998 — archival night
spotlight.summary: The Phish.net account records Sabotage opening the second set and a Tubthumping encore.
